title: Classic American Chicken Sandwich
description: A simple yet satisfying sandwich filled with juicy chicken, crispy lettuce, and creamy mayonnaise.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Grill the chicken for 6-8 minutes per side, or until it reaches a safe internal temperature of 165°F.
Meanwhile, toast the sandwich buns on the grill.
Spread 1-2 tablespoons of zesty sandwich spread on the bottom bun.
Add a few cups of sliced lettuce on top of the spread.
Once the chicken is cooked, slice it thinly and add it on top of the lettuce.
Place the top bun on the sandwich and serve immediately.
